profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Independent  Contractor
profile.summary: With over 22 years of professional experience, 17 years of Information Technology experience, strong technical skills with JAVA SQL, and strong analytical skills, I can make an important contribution to any Java SQL based application team

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
•	Responsible for new development, enhancement, and production support of IBM's Extract Transform and Load process for their eSMRT and gSMRT reporting applications, a java, db2, client oriented system.  Using RAD (IBM's Rational Software Development Platform), WSAD (IBM’s Websphere Application Development Platform), Clear Case, WinCVS, DBVisualizer, Rapid, SQL, DB2, Ant, and RM Tool, coding was done to meet each individual client's needs.  This was a heavily structured, fast paced development process requiring strict attention to detail and meeting target completion dates.  IBM's production problem resolution process required strong analytical skills to determine root cause and resolution which had to be completed within a strictly enforced time period.

Languages:  JAVA, IBM’s Rational Software Development Platform, Websphere Application Development Platform, Clear Case, WinCVS, DBVisualizer, Rapid, SQL, DB2, Ant, RM Tool, UNIX

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Development of PST’s Timekeeping and Crew Management System for Norfolk Southern Railroad, a COBOL II, CICS, DB2 application with an html front end.  Responsible for design, coding, unit testing, and defect mitigation

Languages:  MVS, TSO/ISPF, COBOL II, CICS, JCL, DB2, SQL, QMF, SPUFI, CHANGEMAN, XPEDITER, FILEAID,  VSAM and FLAT FILE Processing, JAVA

positions.description:
Full life cycle development for the VISA Signature credit card paper stock initiative and Nordstrom’s Charge Sale Percentage reporting system

Languages:  MVS, TSO/ISPF, COBOL II, CICS, JCL, DB2, SQL, SPUFI, ENDEVOR, XPEDITER, FILEAID, PLATINUM, VSAM and FLAT FILE Processing

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•Project Lead for Humana’s Financial Reconciliation Project to meet compliance requirements of Sarbane-Oxley, federal legislation establishing stringent accounting standards.  
•Project Lead - Design and implement the data warehouse for the EYEMED vision care program.  Responsible for assessing resource requirements, design specifications, supervising coding and testing and meeting deliverable deadlines. 
•Tech Lead for performance tuning of the Metavance data warehouse process through enhancements to program structure, optimizing DB2 processing and SQL. 
oCreated design specifications and documentation, application code, job stream JCL, designed and created DB2 tables, wrote and performance tuned SQL, and unit/system tested Transform and Update modules for the integration of data extracted to flat files and uploaded into the DB2 database of EMPHESYS (approximately 200 modules).

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
•Supported ad hoc report processing performing analysis, design, coding, and testing for implementation.
•Re-designed Agency processing for the Collection Strategy System.
•Performed and coordinated analysis, design, coding, unit testing, and system testing for the implementation of the Local Business Initiative of the Credit and Collection System.
•Tech Lead responsible for performance tuning of applications in Accounts Receivable of the Receivable Management System and the General Ledger application.  Analyzed application structure and SQL for performance.
•Production Support Team, responsible for analyzing issues and making changes effecting system performance and meeting on-call requirements.

Languages:  MVS, TSO/ISPF, COBOL / COBOL II, JCL, CICS, MQ SERIES, DB2, SQL, QMF, SPUFI, ENDEVOR, XPEDITER, FILEAID, PLATINUM, FLAT FILES, VSAM, CA-7

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
*Support Loan Origination application on-line and batch processing.
*Worked extensively with clients to ensure accuracy and satisfaction of projects.
Languages:  MVS, TSO/ISPF, COBOL, CICS, JCL, DB2, SQL, QMF, SPUFI, ENDEVOR, XPEDITER, FLAT FILES, VSAM

positions.title: Software engineer
positions.description:
•Supported on-line and batch processing for the Subscription application.
•Reduced run times of UNIX-based Service Order Generator application, by devising files to run parallel on three different machines.  This reduced the processing time from eight to four hours.
•Worked with clients to resolve processing issues and to perform enhancements to on-line and batch processing of DB2-based systems.

Languages:  MVS, UNIX, TSO/ISPF, COBOL II, CICS, JCL, DB2, SQL, ENDEVOR, XPEDITER, PLATINUM, FILEAID, QMF, SPUFI, FLAT FILES, VSAM, CA-7

positions.title: Analyst Programmer
positions.description:
*Worked on MIMS Application Support Team, responsible for analyzing and resolving work orders created by clients.
*Worked with clients in all areas of MIMS to resolve issues.
*Assisted in 'go-live' support at client sites.

Languages:  UNIX, COBOLII, MACRO LEVEL CICS

positions.title: Progammer Analyst
positions.description:
•Supported batch and on-line processing for Adjustments and Deductions, Deal, Coupon Management, Trade Damage, and General Ledger applications.
•Served as member of Release Management Team, providing support for release testing.
•Served as member of Technical Architecture Team.
•Created on-line screens.
•Coded on-line and batch procedures.
•Designed and executed individual applications and system-wide test plans for redevelopment of Quaker Oat’s Core Transaction System.
•Worked extensively with clients to ensure accuracy and satisfaction.
•Adapted quickly to requested changes in design, and successfully met targeted completion dates.

Languages:  MVS, TSO/ISPF, COBOL II, CICS, MQ SERIES, JCL, DB2, IMS, SQL, QMF, SPUFI, XPEDITER, ENDEVOR, PLATINUM, FILEAID, FLAT FILES, VSAM, CA-7
